def params_snapshot(cfg, note=""):
    d = {}
    for k in SPEC:
        if k in cfg:
            v = cfg[k]
            if k in REV:
                name, f = REV[k]
                d[name] = round(v / f, 6)
            else:
                d[k] = v
    if note:
        d["NOTE"] = note
    return json.dumps(d, ensure_ascii=False)
